messages:
toni_marketing: Quick sync  were finalizing the webinar benchmark narrative and need a compact "repro pack" from runtime for the appendix. Must include: exact run command, model tags, quant config, warmup script, warmup tokens/worker, full latency traces, representative outputs (10 per slice), and a brief note on variance. Deadline: tomorrow morning. @evan_runtime can you pick this up?

ev an_runtime: Yep, I can. Which slices? We usually do short Q/A, long context 8k, code-gen, multi-turn chat, and a tiny edge-case slice.

toni_marketing: Those five. Also add a short "how we sampled" README and a CSV with columns: slice, seed, variant, prompt_len, response_tokens, latency_ms, kv_cache_hit, model_tag. Include both fp16 baseline and our demo quant q8_kv.

rachel_ml: For the quant run we used quant-presets/q8_kv_experimental.json. There were two per-layer exceptions for layernorm folding. Will attach the exact file.

artifacts-bot: upload: s3://redwood-bench/webinar/1828009999-pack/ manifest.json (perms: rw-marketing, rw-runtime)

evan_runtime: Plan: run seeds 500-509 for all slices and variants, collect per-token timing, KV cache hits, and export samples.csv + samples.jsonl + logs.tar.gz + reproducibility-notes.md. ETA 10 hours. Also will compute cost-per-1k-token and mark artifacts embargoed until 2026-04-10.

toni_marketing: Embargo OK. Also please include the curl example and a python SDK snippet for the docs.

ev an_runtime: Will include. Also will note the batch knobs used: batch_size=4, batch_timeout_ms=15, prefix_cache=true.

sam_csm: Add customer-success to ACL for artifact access after embargo.

ev an_runtime: Done. Sweep complete. Quick numbers: fp16 warmed p50=28ms p95=82ms p99=185ms; q8_kv warmed p50=34ms p95=120ms p99=350ms; coldstart median ~470ms. Put artifacts here: s3://redwood-bench/webinar/1828009999-pack/ (manifest.json, samples.csv, samples.jsonl, warmup.sh, reproducibility-notes.md, logs.tar.gz).

toni_marketing: Thank you! Pulling samples for slides now. Will ping if edits needed :pray:
